inputs.text: Canada cannot protect its citizens or preserve public confidence if it treats border rules as optional. Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026; now the government must apply it fairly and consistently, rather than backing away whenever critics label enforcement “securitizing.” People fleeing danger, including Nigerians, should be treated humanely—but compassion without clear standards is not responsible protection. A country has a duty to maintain order and defend its authority at the border.
